scope: Native product regression of prescribed Cartesian velocity trace diagnostics; the Python driver only invokes native CLIs and reads their outputs, and is not an independent flow-equation audit.

productChange.summary: FlowResult2D and the CLI now report shared-vertex jumps between every boundary face pair that fixes both Cartesian velocity components, while retaining the narrower legacy wallTrace diagnostic.
productChange.geometryMatching: Final FvMesh2D face endpoints are reconstructed from face centre and area vector and paired only at TolerancePolicy construction-roundoff scale; no geometry welding or repair is performed.

comparisonTolerance.quantity: Euclidean jump of prescribed Cartesian velocity
comparisonTolerance.purpose: Suppress construction floating-point roundoff only; not a physical accuracy or acceptance threshold.

curvedDuct.physics: duct preset, nu=0.1 m2/s, reference speed=1 m/s, omitted method and convection resolved to Newton-Krylov plus face-limited-linear, tolerance=1e-8

traceResultAllLevels.interpretation: The uniform 1 m/s inlet meets stationary no-slip walls at two shared vertices. The increasing pointwise pressure maximum approaches these corners under refinement, so wall-only trace reporting was insufficient. No cells or near-corner errors are removed.

externalCylinder.physics: Re=20 external cylinder, 4904 cells, explicit face-limited-linear, tolerance=1e-8

linuxDesktopPath.scope: Real Electron 37 headless renderer-to-IPC-to-native-CLI run; not a physical-display, macOS or packaged-App qualification.
renderedTextContains: 完整规定速度的相邻边界面未检测到迹跳；仍需压力网格加密验证

qualification.granted: The product now exposes full prescribed-velocity trace incompatibilities needed to qualify pointwise pressure at boundary junctions without modifying the numerical solution.
qualification.notGranted: Pointwise pressure at discontinuous prescribed-velocity junctions remains unqualified; zero reported jumps do not replace mesh, conservation, force or domain-size studies; maturity is not complete.
